name: dark-factory
description: Not an npm package. This file exists for TWO reasons, each guarded by its own test. (1) It is the single authored declaration of the pyright version dark-factory-orchestrator.yaml's type_check_command resolves. That chain is seven bare `npx pyright` clauses (deliberately — see the comment above type_check_command), and npx with nothing installed fetches pyright@latest, so a green main could turn red on an npm publish and two verify hosts could disagree. Keep it equal to uv.lock's pyright (pyright-python) version, which is what `uv run pyright` resolves in every <pkg>/orchestrator.yaml module config and in hooks/project-checks. All of that is enforced by tests/scripts/test_pyright_version_pin.py (task 4538); bump with `npm install --save-exact pyright@<version>`. (2) It declares the dashboard DOM-harness toolchain: jsdom, plus react and react-dom pinned to exactly the version dashboard/src/dashboard/static/redux/index.html loads from the CDN, and the harness renders the .jsx with the development build of that exact react/react-dom package: the installed copy of the build index.html loads is held to the tag's integrity, while the browser itself loads the production build (task 5828). That identity is enforced by dashboard/tests/js/dom_harness.test.mjs (task 4899). verify_cold_preprovision_command runs `npm ci` from the committed package-lock.json in every cold worktree, which installs both and puts this exact pyright in node_modules/.bin for npx to find.
